title: Was blown away by this sub… some eerie connections…
content: I found this sub not too long ago and while reading through it I was struck by how similar these stories are to some of my dreams I had quite frequently several years ago. I haven’t had them in awhile. My version of mall world usually happens in 3-4 different locations. One location is somewhat like a Grand Hotel/Compound/Barracks like building with tons and tons of rooms. Details are fuzzy, but the dreams are always chaotic, like something is about to happen. The second location is in this weird dark neighborhood, almost suburban like and I’m in a car. It’s nighttime and we are driving up this steep road to get to a “House on the hill.” It has a menacing vibe and feels extremely dark. All I know is that I NEVER want to go inside and have such dread about having to. I don’t remember much about the inside besides the fact it has an attic, which is a liminal space. It keeps going forever, through these holes in the walls covered with tin that had to be moved to the side. The third place I haven’t dreamed of a lot. Just maybe one or two times. It’s a place I would call “Dock-world.” It’s almost like wooden stacked docks with wooden stairs over the water in an ocean somewhere. I just remember lots of dark woodwork specifically. Anyone have anything similar? I seen one other persons story talking about a house on the hill and I almost cried. Because that’s one of the dreams that’s always stick with me.
